summary: Default the search command to the local mirror, correct its provenance and freshness reporting, and expose it to MCP.
reason: The only API-side search route is POST /api/v1/linkedin/search, which spends LinkedIn's daily search-result budget; auto-routing a bare search there is a footgun on an API whose own docs state Unipile enforces no limits. The local path also reported api_unreachable without attempting a call and claimed the store had never been synced on every query.
validated_outcome: search now answers from the mirror with no API call, reports local_default provenance, and --data-source live remains the explicit opt-in.
